title: Las Vegas Guided Off-Road Adventure to Callville Wash
includes: Lake Mead Recreation Area Entrance Fee
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
Not recommended for children under 2 years of age
Not recommended for people with motion sickness
Not recommended for people without a driver's license
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Get rocking on your next Las Vegas adventure where each guest gets behind the wheel of their own luxurious Bronco! This trail is our most rugged destination where we can open up and gain the most speed. Whether you're a novice or an experienced Overlander, we warmly invite all levels of experience to join us. Our guides will teach you safe driving techniques to help you enhance your off-road skills and will ensure your comfort while driving on any terrain!

Your adventure begins in the morning at our meeting point at Lake Las Vegas. From here, all drivers will wagon train past the northern shores of Lake Mead to Callville Wash North. This area is renowned for its rugged beauty and unique landscape, offering visitors an opportunity to explore the desert environment and experience stunning views of the surrounding area. Our tour includes lunch, opportunities to learn this destination along the Colorado River, and a chance to explore a hidden and lesser-known area of Las Vegas.
